prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.6 °C (66% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.2 °C (56% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.7 °C (48% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.84 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). A small switching delay appears during the main pressure transient, reflecting early valve degradation.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.57 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 362 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.6 bar (2% below healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.0 °C (69% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.8 °C (58% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.2 °C (50% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.85 s (within 1% of healthy). Valve switching latency remains tightly within normal healthy tolerances.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.59 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.5 bar (2% below healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
